verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no dedicated guardrails feature. Two adjacent mechanisms exist: a Pydantic `output_type` forces responses to match a schema, which is output validation (docs-6, docs-44), and deferred tools can require user approval before a tool runs, which blocks actions (docs-46, docs-55). Schema conformance and tool approval are not content-safety guardrails, so this covers only a thin slice of the story. Missing for 10: input guardrails on user prompts, content-safety checks that block or transform unsafe text, a documented guardrail or validator hook API, and independent corroboration.
